gloss: to draw, to depict, to describe

definitions.explanation: To represent or portray in words.

examples.japanese: {小説|しょうせつ}は{戦争|せんそう}を{描|えが}いている。

notes:
{描|えが}く is a godan verb with three related meanings: to draw/paint, to depict/portray, and to imagine/envision.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: 〜を{描|えが}く

SENSE 1 - TO DRAW/PAINT:
- {絵|え}を{描|えが}く: to draw a picture
- {円|えん}を{描|えが}く: to draw a circle
- {肖像画|しょうぞうが}を{描|えが}く: to paint a portrait

SENSE 2 - TO DEPICT/PORTRAY:
- {小説|しょうせつ}が{戦争|せんそう}を{描|えが}く: the novel depicts war
- {人間|にんげん}の{心|こころ}を{描|えが}く: to portray the human heart

SENSE 3 - TO IMAGINE/ENVISION:
- {未来|みらい}を{描|えが}く: to envision the future
- {夢|ゆめ}を{描|えが}く: to imagine a dream

READING NOTES:
- {描|えが}く (egaku): more literary/abstract
- {描|か}く (kaku): same kanji, simpler/concrete
- {書|か}く (kaku): different kanji = to write
